verdict.rationale: Docs claim GPU acceleration support (llamafile-docs-12) but provide no documentation of diagnostic messages explaining why GPU acceleration failed or fell back to CPU. Community evidence directly contradicts a 'clear diagnostics' experience: one user's CUDA build failed with a compiler error before silently defaulting to CPU (llamafile-comm-2), and another user with a GPU laptop reports the app runs 'almost all' processing on CPU with no indication why, asking how to force GPU use (llamafile-comm-13) — showing the fallback is silent/confusing rather than clearly diagnosed. missing for 10: any documented log/warning message identifying GPU failure cause, first-party troubleshooting guide for GPU fallback, independent confirmation that diagnostics are clear.
